name: NMOS Crawl Tracking
author: NMOS

sections.description:
Connect your WordPress site to the NMOS.NET crawler analytics service.

Plugin author / ownership contact: help@nmos.net

  • Injects the nmos-tracking meta tag in wp_head
  • Loads tracking.js from NMOS.NET via wp_enqueue_script
  • Optional CSS beacon via wp_enqueue_style when JavaScript is limited
  • Admin Dashboard with Free Crawl Analysis (top bots, pages, recent visits)
  • Settings submenu for tracking ID / beacon options
  • Prompts to open the full NMOS.NET panel for Starter/Pro features

Copy your tracking ID from NMOS.NET → My Websites → Copy Meta Tag & Script. Saving a valid tracking ID enables the service on public pages.

This plugin is an independent integration for the NMOS.NET service and is not an official WordPress.org product.

External service

This plugin is an interface to NMOS.NET, a Software-as-a-Service product. When configured, the site loads scripts and a stylesheet from https://nmos.net and may send crawler / technical visit data to NMOS.NET for analytics. The admin Dashboard also requests a site-scoped Crawl Analysis summary from https://nmos.net/backend/api/bots.php using your tracking ID.

  • Privacy Policy: https://nmos.net/privacy
  • Terms of Use: https://nmos.net/terms
  • Data Processing Addendum: https://nmos.net/dpa

By installing this plugin and entering your tracking ID, you authorize the plugin to contact NMOS.NET as described above. No data is sent until a tracking ID is saved.
sections.installation:
1. Install from Plugins → Add New (search “NMOS Crawl Tracking”) or upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Open NMOS Tracking in the WordPress admin sidebar and paste your tracking ID (nmos_…).
  4. Save. Use Check in the NMOS dashboard to verify the install.
sections.faq:
Where do I find the tracking ID?

In the NMOS.NET dashboard, open My Websites, select your site, and copy the meta tag or tracking ID.

What data is sent to NMOS.NET?

Technical and crawler-related visit data used for crawl analytics (for example user-agent and page URL context collected by the NMOS tracking script). See the Privacy Policy for details.

Does this replace Google Analytics?

No. NMOS focuses on crawler and bot traffic visibility, robots/sitemap/llms tooling, and install health — not general marketing analytics.

Can I change the NMOS.NET server URL?

No. The plugin always uses the official NMOS.NET endpoints (https://nmos.net).

How do I contact the plugin author?

Email help@nmos.net or visit https://nmos.net.
